definitions.scope: Original development monitoring; executor and controller updates are separate training stages.
definitions.executor: C and direct-R 26-letter CE, mean nominal loops per example then mean examples. Validation: 576 queries, 64 per trained count 1–6/8/10/12, correlated through shared graph/start pairs. R loss is unscaled (training coefficient 0.25).
definitions.controller: Balanced stop BCE over observed continue/stop classes per example. Training samples 58 requests through 63 with min(N,12) loops; validation is the 1408-query selection cohort, 128 graphs at 11 seen counts up to 12 (excluding 9). Cohorts differ. Numerical auxiliary losses are not included.
definitions.logging: Executor: all 2250 updates. Controller: batch at update 1 and each tenth update, 601 samples; these are not ten-update averages.
definitions.smoothing: Trailing update window over available logged batches, weighted by batch examples. No interpolation of missing training losses. Validation remains unsmoothed.
